## About
R&S Tire and Truck Service is a family company. Owner Bob Schnees started out working for his father, and he still runs the shop with the same dedication to personal service, value and quality tires his father insisted on.
We're the go-to tire provider for Central Ohio's top fleets, and a preferred servicer for truck drivers based here and those passing through Columbus who need repairs and replacements between runs.
Customers rate us 4.6 from 44 Google reviews.

## Services
- Sales: Truck tire sales for commercial, industrial and everyday vehicles. One customer from Gahanna wrote that we beat anyone else in Columbus on the exact same Bridgestone tire.
- Mounting: Tires mounted for trucks, trailers, equipment and more.
- Balance: Tire balancing to go along with new or repaired tires.
- Repair: Tire repair for semis, trailers, equipment and fleet vehicles, whether you're local or traveling through Columbus.
- Retread: Retreads for truck tires. Call to ask about your vehicle.
- Patching: One customer said we patched his tire for the best price out there.
- Calcium Refill: Calcium refill service. Call to ask whether it's right for your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: You can call to schedule maintenance. One reviewer came in with no call ahead and was all set quickly.

Q: Do you work on my type of vehicle?
A: We handle semis, trailers, commercial and industrial vehicles, construction and farm equipment, motorhomes and recreational vehicles, ATV/UTV and power sports, forklifts, GradAlls, skid steers, buses, cars, light trucks and lawn, garden and golf vehicles. For anything else, give us a call.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 3700 Agler Rd. in Columbus, near John Glenn Columbus International Airport.

Q: Can you help with a tire emergency?
A: Save our information for your next tire maintenance or emergency, and call us during business hours.
